**Finding: Compliant** (rule EXCLUSIVITY, no redline proposed).

The agreement contains no exclusivity or sole-supplier obligation on Northwind:

- **§ 12.3** affirmatively preserves our freedom: nothing restricts Customer from developing, acquiring, licensing, or using any product or service or engaging any supplier, and Vendor acknowledges Customer has made *no exclusivity, non-compete, most-favoured-customer, minimum-volume, or no-hire commitment*.
- **§ 2.1** reinforces this: no minimum quantity or purchase commitment, and a decision not to sign another Order Form is not a breach or shortfall.
- **§ 12.4** is exclusivity running in our favour (Vendor may not market a service competing with our analytics products) — acceptable and retained.
- Other "exclusive" hits (§ 19.x remedies, § 21, § 28.2 jurisdiction, § 30) are unrelated to exclusive dealing.

No narrowing to the fallback is needed since the preferred position is already achieved.
